title: EU AI Act Article 50 — transparency & marking of AI-generated content
doctrine: human-in-the-loop attestation of evidence — NOT conformity certification

checkpoints.requirement: Generator content-marking census current within 30 days
Named providers' marking surfaces tracked for byte changes
Deployer's own end-user disclosure of AI-generated content
checkpoints.guidance: Only the deployer can attest user-facing disclosure — no external measurement can observe it. Human evidence: policy URL + screenshot + owner name.

checkpoints.requirement: Named accountable owner signs this attestation cycle
